about: Beaconsfield is a city on Montreal’s West Island in Quebec, on Lake Saint-Louis between Pointe-Claire and Baie-D’Urfé. Tree-lined residential streets, shore parks, and a suburban commercial strip along Highway 20 characterize a quieter on-island community. About 19,000 people live in Beaconsfield.
